summary: Russia conducted a sustained multi-axis missile and UAV campaign targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Kherson, Sumy, and Chernihiv oblasts with Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shaheds. Ukraine reported 70 missiles launched overnight, with strikes on energy infrastructure including Obukhov, Yuzhmash, AvtoKrAZ, and JTI Ukraine. NATO Military Committee visited Kyiv confirming support, while EU agreed on a 22nd sanctions package and allocated €1.24B for drones/missiles.
key_points: Russia launched Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv to Kyiv Brovary/Boryspil and from Bryansk to Chernihiv, plus reactive Shaheds from Mykolaiv to Vinnytsia Haisyn (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76298).
399 Ukrainian UAVs were reportedly shot down overnight over Russian regions according to Russian MOD (Source: @tass_agency/399268).
NATO Military Committee visited Kyiv for first time in 8 years, 32 representatives, confirmed support and discussed military priorities with Drapaty (Source: @DeepStateUA/23885).
EU ambassadors agreed on 22nd sanctions package covering 1,500+ companies/individuals linked to Russian defense sector (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33803).
Yandex data center in Sasovo hit by UAV attack causing fire affecting part of infrastructure (Source: @tass_agency/399273).
1 Geran-5 struck Lutsk Vishkiv district; 5 Geran-5 shot down over Rivne attempting to reach Volyn (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76295).
Reactive UAVs observed from Black Sea to Mykolaivshchyna, from Chernihiv past Nizhyn to Kyiv, and through Chornobyl zone to Zhytomyr (Source: @kpszsu/83840, 83846, 83798).
Zelensky reported 70 missiles launched; key targets included Obukhov, Yuzhmash, AvtoKrAZ, JTI Ukraine ammunition factory (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33796).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting a sustained multi-axis campaign combining Geran-5 cruise missiles and reactive Shaheds from multiple launch axes including Chernihiv, Bryansk, Belgorod, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Vinnytsia. The concentration of cruise missiles on limited targets suggests preparation for a larger UAV strike on western Ukraine. Key infrastructure including energy facilities, defense plants, and logistics nodes remain primary targets. The volume of UAV activity across Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Vinnytsia oblasts indicates a broad front of operations.

EU agreed on 22nd sanctions package and von der Leyen allocated €1.24B for drones and missiles. Hungary lifted veto on EU accession technical stage. Trump announced upcoming Putin conversation. European public opinion shows 61.1% Italian opposition to military supplies ahead of 2027 elections.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces employed new tactic concentrating cruise missiles on limited targets with small drone packages, possibly signaling preparation for massive UAV strike on western Ukraine. FPV drone unit 'Sever' active in Sumy oblast. Yandex data center Sasovo infrastructure damage indicates expanding targeting of Russian digital infrastructure. FSB detained SBU-directed provocateurs in Zabaykalsky krai ahead of State Duma elections. Ukrainian Territorial Defense corruption in Odessa and looting by Ukrainian soldiers reported.
